generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production-candidate GAME TERRAIN TEXTURE ATLAS, exactly FOUR columns by SIX rows of square full-bleed cells, portrait2:3 overall aspect ratio, ideally1024x1536. NO gaps, labels, borders or outside margin. FIRST reference is user-approved HD1 visual STYLE only: clean hand-painted larger color planes, smooth organic brush shapes, sparse larger grass clumps and broad bark shading, low fine-grain density. It is NOT a reference for added scenery or projection. SECOND reference shows24 ORIGINAL source cells in row-major order with labels outside the squares. Repaint these24 native cells in EXACT row-major layout, respecting the existing coarse color region positions and clipped trunk pieces within every source square. Do not render the label area. Orthographic top-down game tile projection, same as native source; do not make isometric cubes, new heights or standalone objects. All24 output squares fully opaque and fill their complete cell. No characters, buildings, flowers, new props, perspective, text or shadows extending outside a cell. Completely redraw as smooth painted HD, NO enlarged pixel blocks, no stair-step pixel contours, no repeated tiny grass blades or gritty fine pebbles. Keep grass palette olive/lime as sources, with their darker/lighter broad shading variation. Rows1-2: eight green grass variants, first is distinctly darker olive. Row3: first two grass variants; third grass with a cropped brown trunk at UPPER RIGHT; fourth grass with horizontal cropped BROWN TRUNK BAND across TOP. Row4: first three grass variants; fourth is DARK DESATURATED BLUE-GRAY HORIZONTAL SLATTED GRATE with small dark rectangular openings, keep exact horizontal structure, no grass. Row5: grass; grass with diagonal brown trunk in LOWER RIGHT; grass with narrow horizontal brown strip through middle; grass with thick near-vertical brown trunk on RIGHT half. Row6: grass with brown diagonal trunk from LEFT toward LOWER RIGHT; grass with diagonal brown trunk running LOWER LEFT toward UPPER RIGHT; bright grass; grass with broad vertical brown/soil strip at LEFT. These are clipped parts of existing art, do not complete each into a new tree or add branches beyond source shapes. The24 cells will be cropped and assembled using original source masks later. Preserve coarse location of source grass/trunk/grate regions now. No transparency, all output pixels opaque.

style.decision: 沿2026-10-29已定清爽手繪；本批僅完整不透明地表，不改規則。
